text:
maya: heads-up — CI perf check failed on PR #9999, microbench threshold diff +9.3% median latency for kernel-selector path (512 seq). attaching quick logs. :alert:
infra-bot: perf-check report: PR 9999 | bench/micro/kernel_selector | median +9.3% | p95 +12.1% | thresh=5% | job: ci/microperf-512
jon: can someone paste the exact failing numbers and kv cache stats? need to see if it's kernel selection or kv miss storm.
maya: paste from CI run:
```
Benchmark: kernel_selector/512_seq
baseline_median: 18.7ms
pr_median: 20.5ms  # +9.6%
p95: 33.4ms -> 37.5ms
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.88 -> 0.62  # 88% -> 62%
batch_wait_avg: 0.9ms -> 1.4ms
```
liam: interesting — KV hit rate drop looks correlated. but batch_wait also increased. suspect the sampler/window change merged in batch-scheduler (commit 8f7d2c4) last week. git bisect pointing there?
kai: I repro locally against the exact benchmark (same seed/trace). flamegraph shows heavier spinning in kernel-chooser when seq len ~512 and batch sizes 8-12. commit blamed is `8f7d2c4` in batch-scheduler: "adaptive-window: prefer earlier flush to reduce latency" — that changes when we flush and how we prefer kernel variants.
jon: can you paste the bisect/git commands you ran? I want to rerun quickly on CI runner.
liam: bisect steps I used:
```
git bisect start HEAD origin/main
git bisect good origin/main~10
git bisect bad 8f7d2c4
# ran microbench harness script ./tools/ci/run_microbench.sh --profile kernel_selector/512
```
kai: flame snippet (tiny):
```
kernel_selector_choose() +0.9ms
  -> compute_costs() +0.5ms
    -> eval_batch_policy() +0.3ms
kv_cache_lookup() +0.2ms  # more misses hitting further paths
```
maya: given this is > thresh and blocks the PR, can we hold the rollout and open a revert? tagging as rollout-blocker. @sara can you coordinate the revert + hotfix plan?
sara: on it. I'll open a revert PR for 8f7d2c4 and pin the kernel-selector config to the previous heuristic for Dedicated/stable lanes. Also scheduling a quick canary of the revert in staging. assigning oncall and ENG-RT to review. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks — I'll attach the CI artifacts and the bisect notes to the revert PR (will reference this thread). leaving the original PR blocked until we resolve.
